title: Jira & Agile Delivery
blurb: Agile, Scrum and Kanban from the official guides, then Jira the way engineering teams really use it: work items, workflows, boards, sprints, JQL, reports and their misuse, automation and smart commits - with interactive boards, a JQL playground and auto-graded metric and query problems.
sources: Schwaber & Sutherland, The Scrum Guide (2020), https://scrumguides.org/scrum-guide.html
Manifesto for Agile Software Development and its principles, https://agilemanifesto.org/
Atlassian Support, Jira Cloud documentation (JQL, workflows, boards, reports, smart commits, automation)

modules.title: 1. Agile and Scrum Foundations
modules.summary: What agile means, how Scrum is built on empiricism, and who is accountable for what.

lessons.title: What agile is: four values, twelve principles
Scrum theory: empiricism, pillars and values
Scrum accountabilities: Developers, Product Owner, Scrum Master

modules.title: 2. Scrum Events and Artifacts
modules.summary: The five events with their timeboxes, the three artifacts and the commitment attached to each.

lessons.title: The Scrum events and their timeboxes
Artifacts and commitments: Product Goal, Sprint Goal, Definition of Done

modules.title: 3. Kanban and Flow
modules.summary: Visualising work, limiting work in progress, pulling, and the four flow measures.

lessons.title: Kanban: workflow, WIP limits, pull and service level expectations

modules.title: 4. Backlog Craft
modules.summary: Writing user stories, splitting epics into small slices, and estimating with story points.

lessons.title: User stories, INVEST and acceptance criteria
Epics, stories, initiatives and splitting work
Estimation: story points, planning poker and their limits

modules.title: 5. Jira Fundamentals
modules.summary: What Jira is, its data model of spaces, work types and fields, and the two kinds of space.

lessons.title: What Jira is: sites, spaces, keys and the new names
The Jira data model: work types, hierarchy and fields
Team-managed and company-managed spaces

modules.title: 6. Workflows, Boards and Sprints
modules.summary: Statuses and transitions, boards with column mapping and WIP limits, and running sprints in Jira.

lessons.title: Workflows: statuses, transitions and status categories
Boards: columns, WIP limits, swimlanes and quick filters
Backlog refinement and sprint planning in Jira

modules.title: 7. Jira Query Language
modules.summary: Searching with JQL from the first clause to history operators, then saving filters and building dashboards.

lessons.title: JQL basics: field, operator, value
JQL operators in depth
JQL functions, dates and ordering
Advanced JQL: history, hierarchy and board filters
Filters, subscriptions and dashboards

modules.title: 8. Reports and Metrics
modules.summary: Burndown, burnup, velocity and the sprint report; cumulative flow, control charts, forecasting and DORA.

lessons.title: Scrum reports and how they are misused
Flow reports, forecasting and DORA

modules.title: 9. Automation and Developer Tools
modules.summary: Automation flows, issue keys in branches and commits, smart commits and permissions.

lessons.title: Automation: triggers, conditions, actions and branches
Jira and your code: keys, smart commits and permissions

modules.title: 10. In Practice and in Interviews
modules.summary: A sprint from planning to retrospective, service desks and scaling, and the questions interviewers ask.

lessons.title: A sprint in the life of an engineer, service desks and scaling
Interview readiness: process and behavioural questions
